cards.text:
CELESTIAL BODY
Sun

Taurus · House 3

TRADITIONAL INTERPRETATION

This tradition associates it with conscious identity, purpose and creative vitality.

Sun in Taurus

A steady identity takes shape through tangible experiences, familiar comforts and dependable effort. Security supports persistence, while attachment can make necessary change difficult.

Sun in house 3

Learning and sharing ideas provide a stage for confidence, curiosity and intellectual self-expression.
cards.name: sun-card

cards.text:
Venus
Neptune

Square

TRADITIONAL INTERPRETATION

This tradition reads square as competing demands or tension that can provoke effort, adaptation and action when an easy accommodation is unavailable.

Venus in 
Aries

Affection begins directly and playfully, seeking spontaneity while learning patience beyond pursuit.

and
Neptune in 
Capricorn

Practical ideals favor responsible order, while attainable expectations give aspiration a durable structure.
cards.name: venus-neptune-card

cards.text:
ASTROCARTOGRAPHY LINE
Venus · AC — Rising

Rising across the geometric horizon

TRADITIONAL INTERPRETATION

Venus lines are associated with affection, beauty, comfort and abundance.

The AC theme concerns personal presentation and how one meets the world.
